summary: Short, steep kerb at a junction, houses and flats within 15 m.

drivers.seclusion: Houses and apartments within 13 to 16 m, flats beside; closely overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Grass and kerb beside a narrow street; a couple of cars park here, little spare room.
drivers.traffic: Arterial road just west, quiet side street.
drivers.convention: A few cars park here, no signs on this side.

sun_shade: Open to sun; trees to the south-east.

best_section.where: South kerb of Bellevue Terrace by the main road corner
